logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Editorial illustration for the WO-04 client decision brief (packaging-robot domain, energy-first selection policy). Show a side-by-side comparison of four robot cell packages on a shared acceptance-batch test rig: P1 (6 kWh, winner, robust 1/5 defect margin), P3 (14 kWh, fallback), P2 and P4 (40 and 67 kWh, both at the 5/5 defect ceiling). Convey the energy-first policy visually: a rising energy ladder with the P1 minimum as reference, gap callouts of +8/+34/+61 kWh and cost ratios 2.33x/6.67x/11.17x, and defect-headroom chips showing four defects of slack for P1/P3 versus zero for P2/P4. Flat technical style, navy and teal palette on white, clean labels, no decorative filler, no photographic elements.
